name: Stripe
label: Stripe — Stripe REST v1, pin 2026-07-29.dahlia (Stripe-Version)
description: Stripe API at https://api.stripe.com. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api. POST bodies are application/x-www-form-urlencoded (official). payment_intent_create requires amount (integer cents) + currency. Bearer secret_key. Optional Stripe-Version from config api_version. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log secret_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Stripe. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: balance_get | payment_intent_create | payment_intent_get | payment_intent_confirm | customer_create | customer_get | customer_list | customer_update | customer_delete | coupon_create | coupon_list | meter_event_create | refund_create | subscription_create | invoice_get | payout_list | charge_get | charge_list | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit for payment_intent_create (required) and refund_create. Example: 2000 = $20.00 USD.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO currency lowercase for payment_intent_create (required) and coupon_create. Example: usd.

schema.label: payment_method
schema.description: Request-body parameter `payment_method` for operations: payment_intent_create, payment_intent_confirm.

schema.label: customer
schema.description: Request-body parameter `customer` for operations: payment_intent_create, subscription_create. Required by: subscription_create.

schema.label: confirm
schema.description: payment_intent_create confirm. true confirms immediately when payment_method is set.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operations: payment_intent_create, customer_create, customer_update.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Request-body parameter `email` for operations: customer_create, customer_update.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `name` for operations: customer_create, customer_update, coupon_create.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Query-string parameter `limit` for operations: customer_list, coupon_list, payout_list, charge_list.

schema.label: starting_after
schema.description: Query-string parameter `starting_after` for operation: customer_list.

schema.label: percent_off
schema.description: coupon_create percent_off 1–100. Mutually exclusive with amount_off.

schema.label: amount_off
schema.description: coupon_create amount_off in cents. Requires currency.

schema.label: duration
schema.description: Request-body parameter `duration` for operation: coupon_create.

schema.label: event_name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `event_name` for operation: meter_event_create. Required by: meter_event_create.

schema.label: payload
schema.description: meter_event_create payload map. Official keys include stripe_customer_id and the meter value key. Example: {"stripe_customer_id":"cus_123","value":"10"}.

schema.label: payment_intent
schema.description: Request-body parameter `payment_intent` for operation: refund_create.

schema.label: charge
schema.description: Request-body parameter `charge` for operation: refund_create.

schema.label: items
schema.description: subscription_create items. Official [{price, quantity}]. Required with customer. Example: [{"price":"price_123","quantity":1}].

schema.label: receipt_email
schema.description: payment_intent_create receipt_email.

schema.label: metadata
schema.description: Stripe metadata key/value on payment_intent_create, customer_*, refund_create, subscription_create.

schema.label: automatic_payment_methods
schema.description: payment_intent_create automatic_payment_methods, e.g. {"enabled":true}.

schema.label: capture_method
schema.description: payment_intent_create capture_method. automatic | manual.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: customer_create / customer_update phone.

schema.label: trial_period_days
schema.description: subscription_create trial_period_days.

schema.label: default_payment_method
schema.description: subscription_create default_payment_method.

schema.label: reason
schema.description: refund_create reason. duplicate | fraudulent | requested_by_customer.

schema.label: duration_in_months
schema.description: coupon_create duration_in_months when duration=repeating.

schema.label: identifier
schema.description: meter_event_create identifier for idempotency.

schema.label: timestamp
schema.description: meter_event_create unix timestamp.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: Http Status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: balance_get | payment_intent_create | payment_intent_get | payment_intent_confirm | customer_create | customer_get | customer_list | customer_update | customer_delete | coupon_create | coupon_list | meter_event_create | refund_create | subscription_create | invoice_get | payout_list | charge_get | charge_list | trigger. Default balance_get. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Key
configurationParameters.description: Stripe credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Api Version
configurationParameters.description: Optional Stripe-Version header (YYYY-MM-DD). Wired as extraHeaders when set.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Signing Secret
configurationParameters.description: Stripe webhook endpoint signing secret (whsec_...) verified against Stripe-Signature (t={ts},v1={sig}). Never logged.
